name: openhands-desktop
description: Native desktop app for the OpenHands agent: Electron shell + React UI + Python sidecar

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace apps/ui && npm run build --workspace apps/shell
scripts.build:exe: npm run build && npm run dist --workspace apps/shell
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/ui && npm run test --workspace apps/shell
scripts.test:all: npm run test:sidecar && npm run test
